title: Using machine learning to predict carotid artery symptoms from CT angiography: A radiomics and deep learning approach
summary: In 132 carotid arteries, CTA radiomics and CNNs were compared with calcium scoring for symptomatic/culprit status. Radiomics had mean AUC 0.96 for symptomatic versus asymptomatic and 0.75 for culprit versus non-culprit, above the comparator approaches; authors call for prospective clinical validation. This supports a retrospective imaging result, not clinical deployment.
